activePlots.summary: The Sun Throne has taken Calder Mill and razed Fenwick. Last Lantern leads a coalition with the Marrow League. Legionaries attacked on day 906 and were driven off with heavy losses on both sides.
activePlots.publicHint: The Sun Throne razed Fenwick and is besieging the Marrow League

previousBulletins: Fenwick is gone. The Sun Throne's legions burned it to the ground; the Starling Tribe has taken in the survivors and asked, politely, that nobody follow them.
The Marrow League now holds three towns. It held seven at the start of the year. Arithmetic is not on its side, but Last Lantern apparently is.
